ledger.x: 1922: the Irish Free State is established on 6 December 1922 as a Dominion under the Anglo-Irish Treaty (signed 6 December 1921), comprising 26 of Ireland's 32 counties.
1937: the Constitution of Ireland, approved by plebiscite on 1 July 1937, takes effect on 29 December 1937; the state is named Ireland (Eire) and a President replaces the Governor-General.

certainty.note: The land border is the county line of the Government of Ireland Act (in force 3 May 1921), confirmed by the Boundary Commission settlement of 3 December 1925 which left it unchanged; the Treaty Ports were British-garrisoned Irish territory.
